args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Medications
- Travel insurance information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes/sandals
- Hat and sunglasses
- Sleepwear

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots/shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit

Personal Care:
- Toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Deodorant
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Contact lenses/solution (if needed)

Electronics:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Waterproof speaker

Miscellaneous:
- Books/magazines for relaxation
- Travel pillow and eye mask
- Snacks for travel days
- Small umbrella or rain jacket
- Laundry bag
- Ziplock bags for wet items
